article_notes: Ukrainian university-clinic study: 50 dogs with acute babesiosis (large Babesia on smear, species not typed) vs 50 healthy controls. All results (Tables 2-8: platelets, aggregation, haematology, blood volume, blood pressure, coagulogram, fibrinolysis, SFMC/FDP/fibrinogen) are infected vs healthy comparisons. Three dogs died but no marker is compared by outcome. Nothing against severity.
